keySentence: Her kindness changed everyone she met — positivity is contagious.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna gave kindness to all the people she met. Her smile passed from one heart to another. Soon the whole town felt warm and happy. Her kindness changed everyone she met — positivity is contagious.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna's kindness spread through the town like sunlight. She never asked for anything in return. She just gave her warmth freely. One smile led to another. One kind word opened a closed heart. When Pollyanna was injured and could not walk, the whole town wept. Her kindness changed everyone she met. Positivity is truly contagious.
facts.Word cards: changed = 변화시켰다 / positivity = 긍정 / contagious = 전염되는 / spread = 퍼졌다
